title: PDV Phase 17 decay model contract
notes: Phase 17 owns the passive dawn decay bridge between Phase 16 neglect and Phase 18 player-facing status.
The locked model is per-deity linear decay after a grace period, once per in-game day, with tier floors and broad-worship reduced-rate drift.
Active patrons are skipped by passive decay; non-patron deities can still drift while an active patron is protected.
Runtime proof completed on 2026-05-28 after fixing fresh-save eligible decay and persistent tier-floor behavior.

Balancing retune applied on 2026-06-02: grace shortened to 2 days, daily gains scale by 1.32 before the existing 4.3 cap, deity thresholds now use 25/50/85, and vampire Aedric/Divine decay bypasses passive tier floors.

remainingDeferred: per-deity authored decay tuning beyond the default model

rules: the decay constants and balancing retune constants stay at the locked defaults
passive decay skips the active patron while allowing non-patron drift
decay respects grace, once-per-day guard, broad worship multiplier, and persistent tier floors
vampire curse state bypasses passive tier floors for records marked IsAedric
tier-down hysteresis holds the current tier within 5 piety of the old threshold
the MCM debug proof controls remain wired to manager-owned helper functions
